text:
Nina (Design): Heads-up: updated the "pill switch" used in the Insights header. Trying a micro compact variant for narrow dashboards. Two quick concerns: 1) label truncation at ~56px, 2) focus ring gets cropped by the container shadow on dark theme. Thoughts? Sam (Frontend): I pulled the build. The visual pill is fine, but clickable area is ~36x28. We should meet 44x44. Could add invisible padding via ::before or use hit-area wrapper. Priya (Product): Users rely on that control to switch modes quickly. If we expand hit area we lose tight spacing in the header. Maybe we can collapse other elements when mobile layout triggers. Rory (A11y): Strong recs: ensure role="switch" isn't used for segmented controls. Use role="tablist"+role="tab" or role="radiogroup"+role="radio" depending on semantics. Example: ```html
``` And, bump hit target to 44px and avoid clipping focus by applying outline-offset or an outer focus ring element. Also make sure the label text is announced: use aria-label if you shorten visible text. Nina (Design): Good call on radiogroup. For copy I was toggling between 'Metrics' and 'Full metrics' to indicate density. Any preference? Priya (Product): I prefer 'Metrics' for compact. If we need to convey density, perhaps a secondary microcopy or tooltip reads "Full metrics (detailed)". Sam (Frontend): Implementation plan: wrap each button in a 44px hit wrapper (display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center) and then visually scale the inner pill to 32px. That preserves layout but increases interactive area. Will prototype. design-bot: image uploaded: https://files.redwood/snap/pill-switch-comp-1.png Rory (A11y): For keyboard nav, radio semantics will let arrow keys move selection. Also ensure contrast of focus indicator meets 3:1 against the background of the container if it's used as an active indicator. Nina (Design): About truncation: propose using a hidden-expanded label for small viewports, via CSS content: attr(data-full) on hover/focus or simpler: always show full label on mobile, truncate only on super narrow screens. Sam (Frontend): I can do responsive label swap with CSS and also add a title attribute fallback for legacy browsers. Will include aria-label for screen readers: aria-label="Metrics view, detailed" when we show shortened text visually. Priya (Product): Let's keep the visible label 'Metrics' on compact headers, tooltip "Show full metrics" and screen reader label "Show full metrics view". That should be explicit. Rory (A11y): Quick checklist for the PR: radiogroup+radio, 44x44 hit area, outline-offset:4px, focus color contrast check, aria-labels on shortened visuals, arrow key support. I'll run axe against the branch. Nina (Design): Action items: @Sam prototype and open PR, @Rory review a11y before merge, @Nina finalize tooltip + sr copy. Thanks! :party_parrot: Sam (Frontend): On it. Branch: feat/pill-hitbox-1846. ETA: Tue morning. Priya (Product): I'll add a follow-up to the mobile checklist for user testing. Nina (Design): Closing thread once PR merged.
